projects.title: BeU: Be Your Best View, Be U

services.title: Anti-Radiation & Blue Light Protection
services.description: Features a multilayer filter that targets high-energy blue light (380nm–450nm) to reduce digital eye strain and fatigue from long hours on screens.

services.title: Sun-Adaptive Photochromic Lenses
services.description: UV-reactive lenses that transition from completely clear indoors to 80% tint opacity outdoors within 30–60 seconds of sun exposure.

services.title: Meta Smart Eyewear
services.description: Next-gen wearable tech featuring an integrated camera, audio, and hands-free connectivity housed in premium titanium and handcrafted acetate frames.

services.title: Fashion Frames & Premium Materials
services.description: A wide array of nonprescription frames crafted from aerospace-grade titanium, stainless steel, and TR-90 plastic built for everyday style and durability.

aboutpara: BeU Eyewear bridges the gap between functional eye care and contemporary fashion. Built for screen-heavy, style-conscious users, BeU offers a collection ranging from anti-radiation and light-adaptive photochromic lenses to hands-free Meta smart glasses. Crafted from aerospace titanium, stainless steel, and handcrafted acetate, every frame provides lightweight comfort and everyday durability backed by a 7-day return guarantee and up to a 5-year warranty.
aboutMe:
Hi! I’m a Computer Science student bridging code with UI/UX design, creating interfaces and high-fidelity Figma prototypes. Beyond tech, I find solace in photography, film, music, and gaming.

Currently featuring BeU Eyewear — an optical brand combining anti-radiation, photochromic, and Meta smart lenses with daily style and functional protection. Welcome to my creative space!
